about: Coach mode: a game against the app's own computer, chosen on the New Game sheet, with a note on any move, a hint, a takeback and the engine's view on request, saved with its notes and opened in Review with them - and no coach control on a game between two people, on the Online sheet, or on a computer game started with it off. Graded by gate 170 (TC-R235a..j) on a trial bundle at 375x761 with his insets and at 320x568, after the game is played. NOT COVERED: a live online game is never entered (the harness has no second player), so the guard there is read on the Online sheet and its sign-in screen only; the quality of the engine's move; the keyboard of a real phone over the note sheet; his phone.

breaks.name: guard-dropped
breaks.why: coach mode no longer asks who the opponent is: a Pass & Play game started with the switch still on gets the note row and the engine's view, and is saved as a coach game

breaks.name: notes-not-saved
breaks.why: the notes are kept on the screen during the game but never written into the saved game, so the store and Review have none

breaks.name: engine-unasked
breaks.why: the engine's view runs by itself on every move of a coach game instead of only when it is asked for
